newsitem.title: USA: U.S. tech stocks soar, while Dow trades in range.
newsitem.headline: U.S. tech stocks soar, while Dow trades in range.

text.p: A powerful rally in the U.S. technology sector took center stage in afternoon trading on Monday, underpinning Wall Street shares.
The Nasdaq composite, heavily laden with technology stocks, surged over 20 points, or 1.36 percent, to 1523.

"There is a lot of excitement in the technology sector going into earnings season," Peter Coolidge, senior equity trader at Brean Murray & Co. "The feeling is that most of these companies will meet or beat expectations."
Shares of chipmaker Intel Corp rose 2-5/16 to 79-3/16, after its stock split two-for-one.
The chipmaker was set to report earnings after the market close on Tuesday.
Microsoft Corp was due to report on Thursday. Its stock added 3-13/16 to 133-9/16.
"We're coming into the height of the reporting period, which is a factor," Frank Calta, managing director of institutional trading at Dain Bosworth, said.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was off session highs, trading up around three points to 7925, while the Standard & Poor's 500 index gained three points, or 0.33 percent, to 920.
The long bond slipped 4/32 to a 6.54 percent yield.
